storage.description: Base directory where reclass stores its cache and generated inventory data.

path.description: Absolute path to the storage directory.

name.description: Logical name for this reclass instance; used for logging and isolation.

metadata.description: Configuration for optional external metadata endpoint (e.g., for dynamic node class injection).

sources.description: List of source directories containing node definitions (YAML files ending in .yml/.yaml) and class definitions.

path.description: Absolute path to a source directory (e.g., nodes or classes).

interpolation.description: Controls whether reclass performs variable interpolation (e.g., ${var} → value) in values.

enabled.description: Enable or disable interpolation of values.

cache.description: Optional caching layer to speed up repeated queries.

ttl.description: Cache validity time in seconds (0 = never expire).

output.description: Output formatting preferences for reclass’s exported inventory.

allowed_types.description: List of allowed output formats (used by integrations like Salt or Ansible).

level.description: Minimum log level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

file.description: Path to log file (empty = stderr only).

max_inheritance_depth.description: Maximum class inheritance depth to prevent infinite loops (lower = safer).

node_name_transform.description: Optional normalization for incoming node names (e.g., strip domain name).

external_data.description: Key-value pairs for static external data (e.g., cloud provider metadata, secrets).

default_node_class.description: Default class name to apply to nodes without explicit classes (e.g., '_defaults').

merge_strategy.description: Strategy to combine dicts and lists during class merging.

diagnostics.description: Toggles diagnostic features (e.g., for troubleshooting node resolution).

show_missing_nodes.description: Print warnings for nodes not found in the inventory.

path_prefix.description: Path prefix to prepend to all file-based paths (multi-tenant setups).

width.description: Line width for YAML output (0 = unlimited).

uri_encoding.description: Encoding method for URIs in external references: 'percent' or 'none'.

naming.description: Regex patterns to validate node and class names.
